supersedes_for_future_execution.reason: v2 multiplied an already zero-padded, bilinearly projected proposal by fractional content occupancy a second time, squaring its boundary weight

scientific_role: final coordinate-only correction for mask-conditioned RAD-DINO descriptors

geometry_contract.proposal: project once from unpadded direct-resize coordinates into the square frame with continuous content_box/padded_side bilinear sampling and zero padding; do not multiply the projected proposal by content occupancy again
geometry_contract.proposal_oversampling: four samples per token axis followed by the unchanged area interpolation to the 32x32 grid
geometry_contract.context: derive the unchanged radius-two dilation from projected proposal occupancy, subtract proposal occupancy, then multiply only this context ring by fractional real-image content occupancy
geometry_contract.flip: flip both the projected proposal and projected content-validity map in square coordinates
geometry_contract.minimum_grid_mass_and_denominators: unchanged from the parent protocol; fractional proposals are not given a new normalization rule in this correction

single_change_relative_to_running_v6: coordinate-frame correction of proposal and context weights before frozen RAD-DINO mask pooling
unchanged_from_parent: all candidate proposals, ordering, metadata and oracle
data split, groups and image labels
all checkpoints and frozen feature layers
scorer, pooling temperature, losses, loss weights and warm-up
seed, optimizer, 16 final-only epochs and TTA scoring
prediction freeze, evaluator, complete misses, bootstrap, gates and operational goals
required_boundary_tests: a direct-resize mask is placed only in the exact square content box
extreme values in padding cannot affect the local-context descriptor
a fractional proposal weight of 0.5 at the content boundary remains 0.5 rather than becoming 0.25
original and flip retained-candidate indices remain identical

execution.launch_condition: audit running v6 first; v3 is eligible only if v6 does not meet all operational goals and its frozen candidate oracle still meets every operational goal
execution.heavy_compute: Kaggle only on two real Tesla T4 GPUs
execution.preflight: complete Torch tests, whole-repository tests, exact source/protocol/split/checkpoint hashes and two-device convolution must pass before candidate generation
execution.candidate_evidence: candidate payloads must be regenerated with the unchanged recipe unless a direct immutable payload mount with every physical hash is available; manifests alone are insufficient
execution.comparison: v3-minus-v6 and both arms versus promoted flip-TTA baseline, paired complete-group bootstrap 10000
execution.monitor: one separate-task monitor at ten-minute cadence

forbidden: executing correction v1 or v2 after v3 freeze
reusing only candidate manifests without physical NPZ payload verification
changing the fractional denominator or any non-coordinate model setting under this correction
validation-GT tuning, hidden result suppression, early consumer training or BTXRD test access
